name: get_metadata
description: Return the method, units, sign conventions, assumptions, example beams, NASTRAN export notes and sources for this beam solver.

name: get_current_beam
description: Return the beam currently on the page (SI units) with its reactions, extremes and values at every support and load.

name: solve_beam
description: Solve a beam given in SI units (supports pin or fixed; loads point, moment or dist) and return reactions, extremes and values at supports and loads. Does not change the page.

items.description: point {kind,x,F N}, moment {kind,x,C N·m CCW+}, dist {kind,x1,x2,q1,q2 N/m}; + up

section.description: {A m², I m⁴} and optional Iy, J, c

name: export_nastran_bdf
description: Return the MSC Nastran SOL 101 bulk data deck (.bdf text) for a beam given in SI units, or for the page's beam when no model is given. The deck's numbers are written in `units` (default: the page's unit convention).

items.description: point {kind,x,F N}, moment {kind,x,C N·m CCW+}, dist {kind,x1,x2,q1,q2 N/m}; + up

section.description: {A m², I m⁴} and optional Iy, J, c

units.description: Consistent unit convention for the deck's numbers
